svg.text: Data layer → prediction brain (expected points) → optimization brain (best moves) → explanation layer (LLM) → dashboard. Coloured tags show the build stage.
bootstrap-static/ players, prices, form, status, teams, GWs
element-summary/{player_id}/ GW history, upcoming, past seasons
entry/{team_id}/ manager overview, current GW, rank
entry/{team_id}/history/ past GWs, chips used, past seasons
Source to decide: own snapshots of the API
and/or a community archive of past seasons
• Enters FPL team ID (from their points
page URL); no scraping, no password
Data layer: backend only (FPL API blocks browser calls via CORS)
• Re-pull after GW deadline and after
first set expires at GW19 deadline)
• FDR over next N GWs per team
Question it answers: "How many points will each player score?"
Features: form, minutes, fixture difficulty, home/away, opponent strength,
past-season history, availability, position, price, set pieces (later)
swaps in behind the same interface
Output: xP matrix = every player × next 1–6 gameweeks
(plus probability of playing), stored for the optimizer and dashboard
Optimization brain: best moves (integer linear programming)
Question it answers: "Given my squad and constraints, what should I do?"
Maximise: expected points over the planning horizon, minus hit costs
• budget = bank + selling prices • 2 GK / 5 DEF / 5 MID / 3 FWD
• max 3 players per club • valid XI (1 GK, ≥3 DEF, ≥2 MID, ≥1 FWD)
• free transfers; each extra transfer = −4 • chip availability & rules
transfers in/out (injuries weighed, not hard-coded) · roll or use FT ·
captain/vice · starting XI & bench order · when to play WC / FH / TC / BB
Output: ranked plans, each with expected point gain
Input: the optimizer's chosen plan + the numbers behind it (xP, fixtures, injury status, price, form).
Output: a readable reason, e.g. "Sell Watkins (doubtful, 3 hard fixtures). Buy Isak (4 easy fixtures, +6.2 xP over 5 GWs, within budget)."
Rule: it explains decisions; it never makes them or invents numbers. All numbers come from the two brains.
• Player list: price, price trend, form, ownership, status, xP
• Fixture ticker + FDR: which teams have the easiest next few fixtures
• Best players for the next few fixtures (by position / price band)
• My team: squad, bank, free transfers, chips left, last GW performance
• AI recommendations: transfers, captain, bench, chip timing + explanations
Team ID in → squad, budget, chips printed
STAGE 2 · Naive optimizer, end to end
ep_next or form × FDR → real suggestions, no ML
Trained on history; swapped in behind same interface
